A RESORT GETAWAY
OF PRISTINE BEAUTY
The Rain Forest Resort Village is set in the beautiful Quinault Rainforest on the shores of picturesque Lake Quinault.
We are situated on the Olympic
Peninsula at the northern end of Grays Harbor County. Lake Quinault's pristine glacier fed waters lap at the beach of our resort.
The Quinault Rainforest, which is framed by Quinault Valley with ridges that rise over 3000 feet, is the backdrop for The Rain Forest Resort Village.

Parkside Suites
Our newest accommodation on our lower park grounds. These Suites are some of the nicest rooms on the lake. They have a gas fireplace in the living room with a large deck overlooking the lake.
A queen size bed in the comfortable bedroom and a jetted tub in the bathroom. The rooms have TVs, refrigerators and microwave ovens.
These two rooms 210 & 211, are very comfortable and have a great view of Lake Quinault.
No smoking or pets allowed in Parkside Suites.
